resources.string: Tu día, claro y en privado.
HeroLogs organiza señales y anotaciones que vos elijas para ayudarte a entender tus días sin presión.
Tus datos se quedan en tu teléfono.
No hay cuentas ni servidores en la nube en este MVP. Todo tu historial permanece guardado localmente en tu dispositivo.
Vos decidís qué compartir más adelante.
En el futuro podrás activar de forma opcional ubicación, reconocimiento de actividad física o datos de salud. Hoy no te pedimos ningún permiso.
Ningún permiso del sistema es solicitado en este momento.
Podés explorar la Timeline de ejemplo local de inmediato. Tenés el control total para editar o borrar datos cuando quieras.
HeroLogs has no account or cloud sync. Permission status is read on this device.
HeroLogs can access precise location while the app is in use.
HeroLogs has approximate location access, so future timeline detail may be reduced.
HeroLogs works without location. You can choose to connect it later.
HeroLogs can read recognized activity while supported features are in use.
This Android version does not require a runtime permission for activity recognition.
HeroLogs works without activity recognition. Future trip confidence may be lower.
Health Connect is optional and is not configured in this version.
Review how local mode and optional permissions work.
HeroLogs currently stores the following categories only on this device.
Your local day history, including times, titles, confidence, movement corrections, and links to places.
Names and categories for places referenced by Timeline entries. HeroLogs does not currently store coordinates.
Small app state such as whether you completed the introduction.
System permissions stay under Android control
Permission grants are not stored as HeroLogs data. Deleting local data does not revoke location or activity permissions; you can change them in Android settings.
Permanently removes Timeline entries, places, and app preferences. You will return to the introduction. System permissions are not revoked.
This cannot be undone. Timeline entries, places, and app preferences will be removed from this device. Android permission grants will remain unchanged.
HeroLogs could not delete the local database. No app preferences were cleared. Try again.
Timeline entries and places were deleted, but app preferences could not be cleared. Try again to finish.
HeroLogs removed its local data. The introduction will open again.
